blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A court in Lanao del Sur has issued an arrest order for lawyer Levi Baligod and other individuals part of the alleged “18 bodyguards” of former Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Elizaldy Co, due to cyber libel charges filed by a lawmaker. Copies of the document sent by a source to INQUIRER on Friday showed that Presiding Judge Samina Sampaco Macabando-Usman of the Regional Trial Court Branch 8 in Marawi City issued a warrant of arrest against Baligod and 18 other individuals accused of violating provisions of Republic Act No. 10175 or the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012.
